## AI-Assisted Contributions

AI-assisted development is permitted. Contributors remain fully responsible for
all code and other changes they submit, regardless of whether AI tools were used
during development.

AI systems must not be listed as co-authors in commit messages. An AI system
cannot assume responsibility for the submitted work, so AI-generated
`Co-Authored-By` trailers are not accepted.

AI-tool attribution in commit messages is also considered promotional or
advertising content and is prohibited.
AI attribution inside PR/issue comments is fine and encouraged, but not required.

The merge request creator is responsible for reviewing, understanding, and
taking full responsibility for the submitted changes.
